scope: player_facing_text; implementation notes and art prompts remain verbatim

messages.1차 방어선 · 다리 옆 물가 칸: First defense line · waterside spot beside a bridge
messages.느긋하고 고집 셈. 말끝마다 '개굴'은 안 붙이고 대신 '...인데요'를: Easygoing and stubborn. Never adds a ribbit; instead, ends everything with a dry "...you know."
messages.성이 생기기 전부터 천장에서 새는 물이 고인 웅덩이에 살았다. 마왕이 그: Lived in a puddle of ceiling leaks before the castle existed. Believes the Demon Lord built a castle on top of home, and posts a Pond Return Demand on the throne every morning. Finally sides with the Demon Lord when the kingdom plans to fill in the waterway.
[Goldin|Flustered]: My lord, there is wet paper stuck to the throne again.
[Pongdang|Deadpan]: Pond Return Demand number 37, you know.
[Pongdang|Firm]: Then call me a tenant. I'll pay rent by guarding the bridge, you know.
messages.다리·물가 칸 위의 적 하나를 혀로 붙잡아 1.5초 묶고, 3초 동안 이: Snags one enemy on a bridge or waterside tile with a tongue, rooting them for 1.5s and reducing movement speed by 40% for 3s (Wet).
Allies within 2 tiles gain +3 defense for 5s.
+10% attack while standing at a waterside defense spot.
Puddle Song range becomes 3 tiles; defense bonus becomes +4.
messages.퐁당은 37번째 요구서 끝에 작은 글씨로 '다리는 지켜 드림'이라고 덧붙: At the bottom of demand number 37, Pongdang added a tiny note: "Will guard the bridge."
Whoever owns the place, the water needs protecting, you know.
messages.비 새는 밤의 노래: A Song for a Leaky Night
messages.천장이 가장 많이 새던 밤, 퐁당은 양동이마다 다른 음을 맞춰 식구들을: On the leakiest night, Pongdang tuned each bucket to a different note and sang the family to sleep.
Even drips make a lullaby if the beat is right, you know.
messages.퐁당은 마지막 요구서를 찢고 '우리 연못'이라고 쓴 팻말을 다리 옆에 박: Pongdang tore up the final demand and planted a sign beside the bridge: "Our Pond."
I'm dropping the demand. It's our pond now.
messages.실키 — 거미줄 다리(다리 위 적 속박 연계): Silky — Web Bridge (rooting combo against enemies on bridges)
messages.모든 일에 늦지만 절대 포기하지 않는다. 말이 느려서 대사 중간에 점(…: Always late, but never gives up. Speaks slowly, with lots of pauses (...).
messages.이사를 제때 끝내 본 적이 한 번도 없다. 등 껍질이 곧 집이라 '고향': Has never finished moving house on time. With a home on its back, never understood "hometown." When the family steps around the slime trails left on the castle floor, Neurit finally chooses somewhere to stay.
[Bati|Dry]: The guest who left the entrance three days ago has just arrived.
messages.[마왕|감동]: 사흘을 걸어왔다고? 그 끈기, 마왕성에 필요하다!: [Demon Lord|Moved]: You walked for three days? This castle needs that persistence!
messages.[골딘|계산]: 유지비가 하루 식량 1입니다. 이동 속도 대비 아주 합리: [Goldin|Calculating]: Upkeep is 1 food a day. Very reasonable, considering the walking speed.
messages.앞쪽 길 칸 하나에 6초 동안 끈끈이 웅덩이를 만든다(끈끈이 함정과 같은: Creates a sticky puddle on one road tile ahead for 6s (same effect as a sticky trap).
At 35% HP or below, hides in the shell and reduces damage taken by 60% for 4s.
Sticky traps within 2 tiles last 2s longer.
Max HP +20%; Shell Retreat damage reduction becomes 70%.
messages.느릿은 마왕에게 인사하러 왕좌까지 가는 데 하루가 걸렸고, 마왕은 그동안: Neurit took a whole day to reach the throne and say hello. The Demon Lord stayed put the entire time.
You're... the first... to wait... for me.
messages.식구들이 느릿의 점액 자국을 밟지 않으려고 까치발로 돌아가는 걸, 느릿은: Neurit watched for a long time as the family tiptoed around the slime trail instead of stepping on it.
A home... that protects... my little trails.
For the first time ever, Neurit unpacked the shell and placed each belonging on a barracks shelf.
messages.여기서는… 천천히… 살아도… 되죠?: Here... it's okay... to take... my time?
messages.핀 — 미끈불길(점액 위 불길 지속 연계): Pynn — Slippery Flames (longer-lasting fire on slime)
Huge body, soft heart. Gets teary whenever jobs come up.
messages.왕국이 강마다 튼튼한 돌다리를 놓으면서 통행세 받던 일자리를 잃었다. 비: Lost a toll-collecting job when the kingdom built sturdy stone bridges over every river. One look at the castle's rotten wooden bridge and Beongbeong submitted a resume: "This one needs me." Thinks every upgrade from wood to stone to gate bridge is a personal promotion.
messages.[벙벙|간절]: 이력서입니다! 경력: 다리 지키기 40년!: [Beongbeong|Pleading]: My resume! Experience: 40 years guarding bridges!
[Bati|Checking]: Your reason for leaving was "the bridge got too sturdy."
messages.[벙벙|울먹]: 이 다리는… 이 다리는 정말 금방 무너질 것 같아요! 제: [Beongbeong|Teary]: This bridge... this bridge looks ready to fall apart! It needs me!
[Demon Lord|Conflicted]: I'm unsure whether that's praise or an insult. You're hired.
messages.도둑 계열을 때리면 그 도둑이 훔치던 진행도를 초기화하고, 훔친 금화의: Hitting a thief-type enemy resets their stealing progress and makes them drop 50% of their stolen gold.
Standing on or directly beside a bridge grants +4 defense and +10% max HP.
No Passage range becomes 2 tiles; taunt lasts 4s.
Recover 100% of gold dropped by Toll Shakedown after battle.
messages.벙벙의 이력서 뒷면에는 지금까지 지킨 다리 이름이 빼곡했고, 마지막 칸은: The back of Beongbeong's resume listed every bridge ever guarded. The last line was blank.
That blank... is for this bridge's name.
messages.나무다리가 돌다리로 바뀐 날, 벙벙은 자기가 승진했다며 넥타이를 매고 나: When wood became stone, Beongbeong arrived wearing a tie, certain it was a promotion.
messages.다리가 단단해지면 저도 단단해져야죠!: If the bridge gets tougher, so must I!
messages.벙벙은 다리 옆에 '이 다리가 무너지면 제가 다리가 됩니다'라는 팻말을: Beongbeong carved a sign beside the bridge: "If this bridge falls, I'll be the bridge."
I wasn't looking for a sturdy bridge. I wanted one worth protecting.
messages.수줍음이 많아 정면으로 말을 못 건다. 항상 누군가의 등 뒤에서 속삭인다: Too shy to speak face-to-face. Always whispers from behind someone.
messages.한 마을 아이의 침대 밑에서 살았다. 아이가 자라 '이제 하나도 안 무서: Lived under a village child's bed, until the child grew up and said, "I'm not scared anymore." Driven out, Shh sought the rumored castle to become someone's fear again. Has yet to realize that being remembered feels better than being feared.
messages.[마왕|흠칫]: …방금 누가 내 뒤에서 '안녕'이라고 했나?: [Demon Lord|Startled]: ...Did someone just say "hello" behind me?
messages.[마왕|허세]: 전혀! 마왕은 겁먹지 않는다!: [Demon Lord|Bluffing]: Not at all! A Demon Lord knows no fear!
messages.전투 시작과 5초간 공격받지 않으면 은신. 은신 중엔 적이 노리지 않는다: Enters stealth at battle start and after 5s without being attacked. Enemies do not target Shh while stealthed. Attacking breaks stealth.
messages.은신 상태에서 공격하면 1.8배 피해, 대상은 2.5초 동안 겁에 질려: Attacking from stealth deals 1.8x damage and frightens the target into fleeing toward the entrance for 2.5s.
Peekaboo fear lasts 3.5s and also frightens enemies within 1 tile of the target.
While stealthed, heals nearby allies for +2 HP/s.
messages.쉿은 처음으로 마왕의 앞에서 인사하려다 실패하고, 대신 그림자 손으로 망: Shh tried and failed to greet the Demon Lord face-to-face, then used a shadow hand to dust off the cloak instead.
messages.병영 막내가 악몽을 꾼 밤, 쉿은 침대 밑에 들어가 밤새 '괜찮아'라고: When the youngest in the barracks had a nightmare, Shh crawled under the bed and whispered "It's okay" all night.
Being beside someone... feels better than scaring them.
messages.이름을 불러 준 날: The Day You Called My Name
messages.마왕이 어둠을 향해 '쉿, 거기 있지?'라고 부른 날, 쉿은 처음으로 그: When the Demon Lord called into the dark, "Shh, are you there?", Shh stepped out of the shadows for the first time.
When someone looks for you, even a shadow has a home.
messages.루미 — 표식 기습(루미 표식 대상에 까꿍 강화): Lumi — Marked Ambush (enhanced Peekaboo against Lumi's marked target)
messages.최종 방어선 도발 탱커·용사 대응: Final-line taunt tank and hero counter
messages.최종 방어선 · 옥좌 앞: Final defense line · in front of the throne
messages.용사 말투를 흉내 낸다. 정의로운 대사를 하다가 자기가 마왕 편이라는 걸: Imitates a hero's speech. Starts a righteous proclamation, then remembers being on the Demon Lord's side and hesitates.
messages.이름난 용사가 은퇴하고 농부가 되면서 창고에 버리고 간 갑옷이다. 속은: Armor abandoned in a shed when a famous hero retired to farming. Empty inside, with only the wish to be a hero left behind. A thief tried to sell it for scrap, then dumped it in the cave. The Demon Lord argued that guarding the throne is heroic too. Dreads the day Leon arrives.
messages.[텅텅|정의감]: 멈춰라, 악의 마왕! 이 몸이 정의의 이름으로…: [Teongteong|Righteous]: Halt, wicked Demon Lord! In the name of justice, I shall...
[Bati|Dry]: You just signed an employment contract with the castle.
messages.[텅텅|당황]: …악의 마왕님, 근무 시간은 어떻게 됩니까?: [Teongteong|Flustered]: ...Lord Wicked Demon, what are my working hours?
[Demon Lord|Pleased]: In front of the throne. The most heroic post in the castle.
Taunts up to 3 enemies within 1.5 tiles for 4s.
messages.전투당 1번, 체력 30% 이하에서 3초 동안 받는 피해 90% 감소 후: 1 time per battle, at 30% HP or below, reduces damage taken by 90% for 3s, then heals 25% of max HP.
Takes 20% less damage from hero-type enemies (Trainee Hero and Leon).
+5 defense within 5 tiles of the throne.
Hero's Stance cooldown -3s; taunt targets increase to 4.
messages.빈 투구 속 이름: A Name in an Empty Helm
messages.투구 안쪽에 새겨진 옛 주인의 이름 옆에, 텅텅은 몰래 '텅텅'이라고 작: Beside the old master's name inside the helm, Teongteong secretly scratched a small "Teongteong."
Even if I'm empty, I should have a name.
messages.푸딩이 젤 손으로 텅텅의 녹을 닦아 주자, 텅텅은 처음으로 갑옷 안이 따: When Pudding polished the rust with jelly hands, Teongteong felt warmth inside the armor for the first time.
I thought heroes stood alone. A hero can have a family, too.
messages.레온이 오기 전날 밤, 텅텅은 옥좌 앞에 무릎 꿇고 옛 주인이 아닌 지금: The night before Leon arrived, Teongteong knelt before the throne and swore an oath to today's family, not the old master.
I don't know about justice. But this post is mine to guard.
messages.원거리 불꽃·은신 탐지·성기사 대응: Ranged fire, stealth detection and holy-knight counter
messages.감시탑·옥좌 주변 (물가 피하기): Near watchtower and throne (avoid waterside tiles)
Jumpy and fast-talking. Screams at the faintest drip from the ceiling.
messages.옥좌 촛대에 꽂혀 있던 마지막 양초다. 초대 마왕 시절부터 타오르다가,: The last candle left on the throne's candlestick. Has burned since the first Demon Lord's reign, trembling daily at the leaks that might put it out. When Selen's holy light fills the cave, Noknok finally steps down: "Lighting this castle is MY job."
[Selen|Solemn]: I shall bring light to this den of darkness.
messages.[녹녹|발끈]: 빛 담당은 여기 이미 있거든요?! 양초 경력 200년!: [Noknok|Indignant]: We already HAVE a lighting expert! Two hundred years of candle experience!
messages.[바티|기록]: 촛대에서 양초가 직접 걸어 나왔습니다. 인사 서류는 제가: [Bati|Recording]: The candle has walked off its candlestick. I'll handle the personnel forms.
messages.[녹녹|비명]: 으악 물방울! …아무튼 잘 부탁해요!: [Noknok|Screaming]: AAH, a drip! ...Anyway, nice to meet you!
messages.불꽃 탄으로 피해 + 2초 이동 속도 20% 감소. 성스러운 계열 적(셀: A firebolt deals damage and reduces movement speed by 20% for 2s. Deals +30% damage to holy enemies (Selen, holy knights and exorcists).
Attack -20% while standing on a waterside tile.
Candlelight range becomes 4 tiles; nearby allies deal +5% damage on hit.
Wax Drip burns enemies within 1 tile for 2s.
messages.녹녹은 자기 심지가 초대 마왕의 생일 케이크에서 왔다는 이야기를 처음으로: Noknok finally revealed that its wick came from the first Demon Lord's birthday cake.
messages.축하하려고 켜진 불이니까, 쉽게 꺼질 순 없지!: I was lit for a celebration. I can't just go out!
messages.천장에서 물이 새자 녹녹은 비명을 지르면서도 식구들 침대 위의 양동이부터: When the ceiling leaked, Noknok screamed but moved the buckets above the family's beds first.
messages.무서운 건 무서운 거고, 할 일은 할 일이야!: Being scared is one thing. Getting the job done is another!
messages.마왕이 옥좌 위에 작은 지붕을 달아 주자, 녹녹은 처음으로 떨지 않고 밤: After the Demon Lord put a little roof above the throne, Noknok burned through the night without trembling for the first time.
I can stay lit here. There's a roof looking out for me.
messages.방어선 사이 기동·공병 대응: Mobility between defense lines and engineer counter
messages.방어선 사이 빈 수비 지점: Empty defense spots between defense lines
Talks like a site foreman. Never takes off the hard hat and shouts "Safety first!"
messages.왕국 공병대에 고용돼 마왕성 밑을 파다가 갱도 붕괴 때 버려졌다. 구해: Hired by the kingdom's engineers to dig beneath the castle, then abandoned in a tunnel collapse. Gob, passing by, was the one who rescued Papa. Knows every engineering routine and bad habit, and puts that knowledge into sabotaging their work with heartfelt enthusiasm.
messages.[곱|자랑]: 곱이 땅에서 뭐 주웠다! 안전모 쓴 두더지!: [Gob|Boasting]: Gob found something in the dirt! A mole in a hard hat!
messages.[바티|확인]: 왕국 공병대 출신이군요. 공사 일정표를 외우고 있습니까?: [Bati|Checking]: Former kingdom engineer, then. Do you know their construction schedule?
[Papa|Grinning]: More than that. I know exactly which bits are shoddy.
Instantly moves to another empty defense spot with enemies nearby, on the same or next defense line.
Against engineers and shieldbearers: interrupts actions for 2.5s and reduces defense by 3 for 4s.
After Tunnel Hop, nearby allies gain +3 defense for 2s.
messages.파파는 붕괴 때 마지막까지 동료 공병의 이름을 불렀지만, 돌아온 건 곱의: Papa kept calling the other engineers' names during the collapse. Only Gob's voice answered.
I was the one shouting "Safety first." Not the ones who left me.
messages.파파는 마왕성 밑 굴 지도를 그려 바티에게 건넸다. 비상 탈출로에는 식구: Papa drew the tunnels under the castle for Bati. The emergency exits had one mark for each family member.
A site is only safe when everyone has a way out.
Papa gave Gob a little hard hat exactly like his own.
The friend who saved you deserves the very best gear.
messages.돌콩 — 지하 행진(굴 이동 후 돌콩 방어 연계): Dolkong — Underground March (tunnel movement into Dolkong's defense combo)
messages.1차 방어선 · 입구 쪽 갈림길: First defense line · fork near the entrance
messages.자신감은 넘치는데 방향 감각이 없다. 틀린 길을 너무 확신에 차서 알려: Overflowing confidence, no sense of direction. Gives wrong directions with absolute certainty.
messages.탐험가들 사이에 돌던 '마왕성 지도'가 동굴 습기를 먹고 깨어났다. 밀로: A "map of the Demon Castle" passed among explorers woke up in the cave damp. The very map Milo complained had three thrones on it. Felt bad about getting people lost, until the Demon Lord praised it as the castle's finest defense.
messages.[밀로|당황]: 이 지도에 왕좌가 세 군데나 표시되어 있는데요?: [Milo|Flustered]: This map has three thrones marked on it?
messages.[마왕|감탄]: 침입자를 헤매게 하는 지도라니, 이건 보물이다!: [Demon Lord|Impressed]: A map that confuses intruders? A treasure!
messages.[골딘|계산]: 종이라서 유지비가 식량 1입니다. 단, 핀 근처는 피하라: [Goldin|Calculating]: Paper, so only 1 food in upkeep. Just tell it to stay away from Pynn.
Changes nearby explorer-type enemies' goals to the wrong building for 4s, within 2.5 tiles.
Allies within 2 tiles gain +15% movement speed for 5s.
messages.불 계열 피해 +30% (약점). 전투 첫 피격 피해 -50%(접혀서 피: Takes +30% fire damage (weakness). Takes 50% less damage from the first hit each battle (folds to dodge).
Wrong Way also affects investigators and lasts 6s.
Map Spread movement bonus becomes +25%; range becomes 3 tiles.
messages.꼬깃은 자기 몸에 그려진 왕좌 세 개 중 진짜가 어디냐는 질문에, 셋 다: Asked which of the three thrones drawn on its body was real, Kkogit insisted all three were the Demon Lord's seat.
messages.왕좌가 하나뿐이면 침입자가 너무 쉽잖아!: With just one throne, it'd be far too easy for intruders!
messages.골딘이 장부 누르는 돌로 꼬깃의 구김을 펴 주자, 꼬깃은 처음으로 자기: Goldin flattened Kkogit's creases with a ledger weight. Kkogit finally read its own map straight.
Now I'm flat... all the roads I drew were leading home.
messages.꼬깃은 몸 한쪽에 식구들 방을 하나하나 새로 그려 넣었다. 그 부분만은: Kkogit drew every family member's room onto one side of its body. That part was never wrong.
I'll get outsiders lost. And make sure nobody inside loses their way.
messages.로로 — 가짜 지도 소동(가짜 발자국+엉터리 길안내 연계): Rolo — False Map Fiasco (False Footprints and Wrong Way combo)
messages.금고·미끼 보물실 앞: In front of the vault or decoy treasury
All three talk at once. Mix union slogans with cheese demands.
Three rats claim they owned this cave long before the Demon Lord arrived. Every stolen coin means less "cheese money," which makes them furious. Signed a collective agreement with Goldin and took charge of vault security.
messages.[찍찍단|합창]: 단결! 투쟁! 치즈 인상!: [Jjikjjik Union|Chorus]: Unite! Fight! More cheese tonight!
messages.[골딘|진땀]: 협상안입니다. 금고 경비를 맡는 대신 하루 치즈 한 조각: [Goldin|Sweating]: Our offer: one piece of cheese a day in exchange for vault security.
messages.[마왕|당황]: 마왕성에 노조가 생겼다고?: [Demon Lord|Flustered]: My castle has a union now?
messages.[찍찍단|합창]: 도둑은 우리가 잡는다! 대신 야근 수당!: [Jjikjjik Union|Chorus]: We'll catch the thieves! But overtime costs extra!
messages.주변 3칸에서 쓰러진 도둑이 훔친 금화를 100% 되찾는다. 주변 도둑의: Recovers 100% of stolen gold from thieves defeated within 3 tiles. Nearby thieves steal 50% slower.
3 quick hits, plus 15% movement speed reduction for 2s.
+20% attack speed at 50% HP or below.
Cheese Money Recovery range becomes 4 tiles; recovered gold +20%.
messages.찍찍단은 협약서에 발도장을 세 번 찍었고, 골딘은 처음으로 지출 장부에: The Jjikjjik Union stamped the agreement with three pawprints. Goldin added "Cheese" to the expense ledger for the first time.
messages.찍! 찍! 찍! (계약은 셋이 지킨다!): Squeak! Squeak! Squeak! (All three of us keep the deal!)
messages.도둑을 잡은 밤, 찍찍단은 수당으로 받은 치즈를 반으로 나눠 느릿에게 가: After catching a thief, the union split its cheese payment in half and took some to Neurit.
messages.제일 늦게 오는 동료 몫은 미리 떼어 두는 거다!: Always save a share for the last comrade to arrive!
messages.찍찍단은 동굴의 진짜 주인은 자기들이라는 주장을 거두고, 마왕성 문패 아: The rats dropped their claim to being the cave's true owners and carved their little names beneath the castle nameplate.
messages.주인 말고 식구로 하자. 그게 더 오래 간다!: Let's be family, not owners. That lasts longer!
messages.미미 — 가짜 보물 작전(미끼 보물실 도둑 함정 연계): Mimi — False Treasure Operation (decoy-treasury thief-trap combo)
messages.보스 약화·아군 대신 맞기: Boss weakening and taking damage for allies
Sounds chilling, means well. "I'll curse you" is a compliment.
messages.도둑 니아가 저주받은 저택에서 훔쳤다가 너무 무서워서 동굴에 버린 인형이: Nia stole this doll from a cursed mansion, then dumped it in the cave out of sheer fright. Silky spent all night stitching its torn seams. Now calls Silky "Mom" and whispers "Give me that pain" whenever family gets hurt.
messages.[니아|질겁]: 그 인형 아직도 있어?! 내가 버린 거야!: [Nia|Horrified]: That doll is STILL here?! I threw it away!
[Nubi|Smiling]: Thank you for that. It helped me find a new mom.
[Demon Lord|Chilled]: ...Good. You're hired. Just make your eyes glow a little less when you smile.
messages.적 하나(보스 우선)에게 6초 동안 받는 피해 +20%, 공격력 -15%: One enemy (bosses first) takes +20% damage and has -15% attack for 6s.
messages.주변 2칸에서 가장 다친 아군 하나가 5초 동안 받는 피해의 30%를 누: For 5s, Nubi takes 30% of the damage dealt to the most wounded ally within 2 tiles.
+10% max HP when Silky is deployed too.
Let Me Hurt for You redirects 40% damage and protects 2 targets.
messages.실키가 마지막 실밥을 매듭짓자, 누비는 처음으로 '저주해 줄게' 대신 ': When Silky tied the final knot, Nubi said "Thank you" for the first time instead of "I'll curse you."
The hands that stitched me... will never get my curse.
messages.누비는 니아에게 '버려 줘서 고마워'라는 편지를 보냈고, 니아는 답장 없: Nubi sent Nia a letter saying "Thank you for throwing me away." Nia left a bag of sweets by the door without a reply.
It's okay to be scared. Come visit next time.
messages.대신 아픈 자리: The Place That Hurts for You
messages.큰 전투 뒤 누비의 몸에 새 실밥이 늘자, 식구들은 돌아가며 한 땀씩 꿰: After a great battle left Nubi with new tears, the family took turns adding a stitch each.
Most of my stitches belong to my family now.
messages.실키 — 재봉 인연(실키 구조 + 대신 맞기 연계): Silky — Sewing Bonds (Silky's rescue and damage-redirect combo)
messages.첫 전투 뒤 모리는 다친 푸딩 위에 포자를 이불처럼 덮어 두고 밤새 곁을: After the first battle, Mori spread spores over wounded Pudding like a blanket and stayed by the bed all night.
Wounds closing slowly hurt the least.
messages.골딘이 왕좌의 곰팡이를 걱정하자, 모리는 곰팡이를 버섯 정원으로 바꿔 ': When Goldin worried about mold by the throne, Mori turned it into a mushroom garden and named it "A Garden of Authority."
Even a damp place can grow something pretty.
messages.모리는 마왕성에서 처음 핀 하얀 버섯꽃을 마왕의 망토 단추 구멍에 꽂아: Mori tucked the castle's first white mushroom flower into the buttonhole of the Demon Lord's cloak.
When this castle grows healthy, I bloom too.
messages.돌콩은 산사태에 굴러 내려와 입구에 박혔고, 아무도 빼내지 못하자 그대로: Dolkong rolled down in a landslide and lodged in the entrance. When nobody could move the stone, it became the gatekeeper.
A rolling stone settles down. Kong.
messages.퐁당이 물을 뿌려 키운 이끼가 돌콩의 목을 감싸자, 돌콩은 처음으로 춥지: When moss watered by Pongdang wrapped around Dolkong's neck, the stone said it no longer felt cold.
Even stone can feel warm. Kong.
messages.돌콩은 한 번도 자리를 뜨지 않은 이유를 묻자, 자기가 비키면 식구들이: Asked why the stone never left its post, Dolkong said moving would block the family's way through.
Where I stand is the door everyone comes home through. Kong.
+5 defense on the entrance defense line.
Statue Pulse range +1 tile; stuns for 1s.
messages.두둠의 북은 왕국 축제에서 깨져 버려졌던 것이었고, 핀이 불로 가죽을 말: Dudum's drum was broken and discarded at a kingdom festival. Pynn dried the hide with fire and brought its voice back.
messages.둥! 다시 울리면 다시 시작이다!: Boom! If it sounds again, we start again!
messages.비 새는 밤, 두둠은 천장 물방울 박자에 맞춰 북을 쳐서 모두의 잠을 깨: On a leaky night, Dudum drummed along with the ceiling drips, woke everyone up, and got quite a scolding.
messages.박자가 너무 좋아서 참을 수가 없었어. 둥…: The beat was too good. I couldn't help it. Boom...
messages.두둠은 식구들 이름을 하나씩 넣은 행진곡을 만들었고, 마지막 소절은 비워: Dudum wrote a march with every family member's name, leaving the final verse blank.
messages.새 식구가 오면 채울 자리야. 둥둥!: That's for the next new family member. Boom-boom!
Replaces the rhythm with -15% attack speed for nearby enemies.
messages.달빛 추적자인 루미는 달이 안 보이는 동굴이 싫었지만, 녹녹의 촛불을 ': Moonlight tracker Lumi hated a cave without a moon, but learned to call Noknok's flame "a little moon."
No moon? Make one. Even a tiny one.
The first day Lumi lost a target, the tracker carried wounded Gob home instead of giving chase.
There'll be more targets. You only get one chance with family.
messages.루미는 식구들 이마에 보이지 않는 달빛 표식을 남겼다. 길을 잃어도 찾을: Lumi left invisible moonlight marks on the family's foreheads, so they could be found even if lost.
My marks were always meant to help me find you.
All allies track the marked target's location; movement +10%.
messages.미미 뚜껑에 붙은 '열어 보지 마세요' 쪽지는, 사실 미미가 수줍어서 스: The "Please Do Not Open" note on Mimi's lid was actually put there by a very shy Mimi.
If you open it... I'll be the first one startled.
messages.미미는 몸 안에 가짜 보물만 넣고 다니다가, 어느 날 식구들이 준 조약돌: Mimi used to carry only fake treasure, until one day a pebble from the family became the first real treasure inside.
I'm not spitting this one out for anyone.
messages.미미는 언젠가 마왕성이 이사 가는 날, 식구들 짐을 전부 자기가 나르겠다: Mimi promised that if the castle ever moved, every family member's luggage would be carried inside.
When the castle grows, so will I. Big enough to hold it all.
First attack against a lured enemy deals +50% damage.
messages.최종 도발 탱커·용사 대응: Final taunt tank and hero counter
messages.기존 계약 시스템에 합류 조건이 이미 있으면 그쪽 우선, 없으면 이 DA: Use any existing contract join condition first; otherwise use this DAY.
messages.정산 때 배치된 몬스터만 유지비. 대기 0. 부족하면 못 받은 몬스터 \: Only deployed monsters pay upkeep at settlement. Reserves cost 0. Monsters that miss their food become Hungry (attack -20% next battle; cannot heal at recovery nests). They do not disappear.
Remove food from building costs (remove the barracks' 2 food cost).
messages.수입 ≈ 명단 전체의 70~75% → 다 세우려면 원정·칙령 식량이 필요: Income is about 70–75% of full-roster upkeep; deploying everyone requires food from expeditions or decrees.
messages.집중 목표 또는 왕명 표적과 인접 보조 적을 기본 간격으로 한 번씩 공격: Strikes the focus target or Royal Order target and a nearby secondary foe once each at the normal attack interval, then walks back to the starting point. Consumes one use on the first hit. Defense falls by 15% for 4s after completion. Ambush inheritance empowers one trap trigger on the target; Vault inheritance interrupts an actual plunder still in progress.
messages.단일 강화 화염구·강화 광역 화염·피해 없는 방어 약화/둔화 저주를 선택: Choose an empowered single-target fireball, empowered area flames, or a curse that weakens defense and slows without dealing damage. Base mana costs are 24/28/16, with a 20% repeat discount, a 30% three-form cycle discount, and Pynn's mana efficiency applied. Two uses per battle.
messages.다른 위험방의 아군에게 안전한 실제 경로를 따라 0.20초 동안 긴급 이: Dashes for 0.20s along a safe, traversable route to an ally in another threatened room. On arrival, grants one ally +20% movement speed, −15% attack interval, and −20% harmful status duration for 6s. Two uses per battle.
